title: The Honour Debt
logline: A retired criminal legend wants to clear an old debt to a rival, but the rival's ambitious successor wants them dead instead.

roles.description: Tired, meticulous, wanting to die with a clean ledger.
Insecure, aggressive, eager to prove they are ruthless.
A heavily guarded vault where old debts are recorded.
The remnants of the legend's former gang.

public_situation: An old underworld figure has resurfaced, causing tension in the local syndicates.
private_truth: The legend isn't here to take over; they just want to pay off a decades-old blood debt to the syndicate before they die.

beats.public_change: The legend publicly requests a meeting with the syndicate.

missions.reason: Needs rare luxury goods delivered as a traditional peace offering to secure a parley.
missions.private_fact: The legend is terminally ill and this is their very last chance.

beats.public_change: The new boss rejects the offering and posts a bounty on the legend.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to scan the syndicate's public ledger to prove the old boss accepted the debt terms.
missions.private_fact: The ledger contains proof that the new boss actually murdered their predecessor.

beats.public_change: The syndicate prepares to strike the legend's safehouse.

missions.reason: The boss hires the pilot to deliver forged records that erase the old debt entirely.
missions.private_fact: The boss is terrified the old crew will rally behind the legend.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the proof of the old debt and the boss's forgery.

options.label: Deliver the forgery and betray the legend
Broadcast the proof of the original debt

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sides with the legend and broadcasts the proof.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate respects the old code. The debt is cleared, and the new boss is overthrown.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the forgery for the new boss.
resolutions.summary: The legend is assassinated in their safehouse. The new boss cements their brutal rule.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the initial missions.
resolutions.summary: The legend is forced to flee the system, their final wish unfulfilled.

loose_threads.detail: The old boss's autopsy report shows traces of a rare, expensive synthetic venom.
The new boss's personal accounts are receiving deposits from a defunct shipping corporation.

radio_hooks: Underworld tensions rise as rumors of an old legend returning spread.
Local authorities advise avoiding the warehouse district.

voice_direction.retired_legend: Gravelly, slow, speaks with absolute finality.
voice_direction.new_boss: Loud, constantly interrupting, trying too hard to sound dangerous.
